description: This file defines a Java interface 'TransactionLifecycleCallback' with default methods for callback hooks related to transaction lifecycle events, such as after beginning, after commit, and after completion.

classes.name: TransactionLifecycleCallback
classes.description: Interface providing callback methods for transaction lifecycle events with default no-op implementations.

methods.name: afterBegin
methods.description: Callback invoked after a transaction begins; default implementation is empty.

methods.name: afterCommit
methods.description: Callback invoked after a transaction commits; default implementation is empty.

methods.name: afterCompletion
methods.description: Callback invoked after a transaction completes; default implementation is empty.
